Sie bereiten Berichte und Abweichungsanalysen auf, erläutern die Ergebnisse und entwickeln das Berichtswesen weiter. Sie wirken an der Weiterentwicklung von Arbeitsabläufen, Systemen und IT-Reporting-Strukturen mit. Das bringen Sie mit Mehrjährige Praxis im Controlling; Erfahrung im Werkscontrolling eines produzierenden Unternehmens ist besonders willkommen. Ausgeprägtes analytisches und konzeptionelles Denken sowie eine hohe Fähigkeit, Lösungen für komplexe Fragestellungen zu finden. Kommunikationsstärke und die Fähigkeit, Fachbereiche wie die Werksleitung für Veränderungen zu gewinnen. Ein paar Worte zum Schluss Für unseren Kunden ist dies eine absolute Schlüsselrolle! Wenn Sie Zahlen nicht nur analysieren, sondern mit Ihren Erkenntnissen

jobs.title: Entrepreneur in Residence
jobs.description: About Act There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting. About the Role We are looking for an Entrepreneur in Residence to help achieve our mission. You will work directly with founders and senior leaders on high-priority initiatives across hiring, market expansion, partnerships, operations, and growth. This role is for highly capable generalists who enjoy solving problems, moving quickly, and taking ownership. We are looking for people who can turn ideas into execution and create meaningful impact from day one. What You Will Be Doing Drive high-priority projects across hiring, operations, growth, and market expansion. Build relationships with candidates, recruiters, universities, communities, and external partners. Support new market launches and expansion initiatives. Help identify opportunities and solve operational challenges. Represent ActAI at events, communities, and external engagements. Work closely with founders on strategic initiatives. Take ownership of projects from concept through execution. What You Will Need Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities. Excellent communication and relationship-building skills. Ability to operate independently with limited structure. Strong execution skills and bias toward action. High ownership and willingness to take on unfamiliar challenges.

jobs.title: Engineering Lead, AI Applications
jobs.description: About Act There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting. Role Lead application architecture and engineering across backend, mobile and desktop platforms Design systems for AI-powered workflows, including orchestration, state management, retries and failure recovery Build and review backend services, APIs and integrations that connect AI systems with product features Make technical decisions on system design, performance, reliability, security and infrastructure Lead a small team of senior engineers through technical design, code reviews and engineering guidance Work with ML and product teams to integrate AI capabilities into production applications Improve system performance, monitoring, testing and production reliability Requirements 8+ years of software engineering experience, including technical leadership of production applications Strong backend engineering expertise, including APIs, databases, distributed systems and cloud infrastructure Experience designing and scaling systems across multiple services or application platforms Hands-on experience integrating LLMs or AI-powered features into production applications Ability to make architecture decisions, review code and resolve difficult engineering problems Experience leading senior engineers through technical design, code reviews and mento

jobs.title: AI Phone - Product Lead
jobs.description: About We are reimagining the phone. AI phones need to be proactive, intuitive, intelligent and low cost. This is a mission critical for rest of the world to adopt intelligence. There are over 5 billion people using everyday applications such as email, messaging, notes, tasks, and calendars, yet most are not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications and devices that bring intelligence into daily conversations, coordination and workflows, with minimal prompting. Focus: AI-native phone experience, user workflows and product direction. Responsibilities Define the overall product experience for the AI-native phone. Identify high-value everyday workflows where AI can meaningfully improve the user experience. Define how users should interact with AI across the OS and different applications. Identify opportunities for proactive assistance and contextual interactions. Translate product ideas into clear requirements for engineering. Work closely with Android and AI teams to evaluate technical feasibility. Prioritize product capabilities for the first prototype and eventual launch. Conduct user research and validate interaction patterns. Ensure that AI capabilities feel natural and effortless rather than requiring users to learn entirely new interaction patterns. Requirements Strong product management experience, ideally with consumer mobile or platform products. Experience building and launching products from early stages. Strong understanding of mobile UX and user behavior. Ability to translate ambiguous product ideas into concrete requirements. Strong technical understanding and ability to work closely with engineers. Good product judgment and prioritization skills. Nice to have Experience with AI assistants, agentic products or productivity applications. Experience with operating systems or mobile ecosystems. jobs.title: Responsable de Projets Conception Bâtiment
jobs.description: À propos d'ELCIMAI Elcimaï Ingénierie recrute : Un Responsable de projets conception bâtiment H/F en CDI Lieu : Melun (77) - Proche de la gare de Melun - 25 min de Paris Gare de Lyon (ligne R ou D) En tant que Responsable de Projets Conception Bâtiment, votre rôle principal est de piloter et produire la conception technique de projets industriels complexes. Véritable référent en maîtrise d'œuvre de conception, vous intervenez dès les études amont pour définir les solutions techniques les plus pertinentes et garantir la faisabilité, la performance et la qualité des projets. Vos missions : concevoir, expertiser, coordonner Vous prenez en charge les études de conception sur l'ensemble des phases de maîtrise d'œuvre : faisabilité, APS, APD et DCE, avec une forte implication dans les choix techniques structurants des projets en conception. Vous êtes le référent technique bâtiment et génie civil auprès des clients et des équipes projets. Vous pilotez ou produisez les études de conception en intégrant les contraintes d'exploitation, de maintenance, de réglementation, de sécurité et de performance environnementale. Vous coordonnez les différents intervenants techniques (structure, fluides, process industriels, architecture, économie de la construction...) pour garantir la cohérence globale des solutions proposées. Vous réalisez les arbitrages technico-économiques et analysez les risques afin d'optimiser les projets dès les phases amont. Vous assurez la relation client sur les aspects techniques et accompagnez les prises de décision tout au long de la conception. Vous pilotez les budgets, les délais et les aspects contractuels du projet. Vous supervisez les phases de réalisation et garantissez la conformité des ouvrages aux études de conception validées. Selon la nature et l'envergure des projets, vous pourrez être responsable de la coordination des phases EXE (VISA, synthèse) et DET jusqu'à la réception des ouvrages Votre profil : Ingénieur Bâtiment / Génie Civil (Bac+5), A

jobs.title: Senior Data Collection Operator (FR)
jobs.description: About Genesis We are a full-stack general-purpose robot company, born across San Francisco, London and Paris and bound by a single mission: to make general-purpose robots a reality, unlocking infinite physical labor for the world and freeing people for creativity, exploration and the pursuits they love for their own sake. We're building the engine that will teach robots to do real work in the real world. We recently unveiled Eno, our wheeled, dexterous robot powered by our GENE foundation model and we are starting to put it to work with real customers. The role General-purpose robots learn from real, dexterous human work, the kind of data that does not exist on the internet. We capture it with our own collection hardware: a person wears it, does the work, and the robot learns to do it too. You will be a senior member of the team scaling our data collection operation in Paris, working closely with our Paris research and engineering teams and with the operation in the Bay Area. You will help lead the day-to-day execution and quality bar on the Paris floor while remaining deeply hands-on with data collection, teleoperation, task setup, and real-robot testing. You will wear our gloves and cameras, teleoperate our hardware, and take ownership of complex collection requests from setup through execution and quality review. You will work shoulder to shoulder with our model engineering and research teams, turning their requests into physical demonstrations and feeding what you learn on the floor back to them. You will be expected to operate autonomously, help guide and train other operators and contribute to how the Paris operation evolves as the team grows. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will not just run existing tasks: you will help shape how they are executed, how quality is measured, and how other operators are trained to deliver consistently. What you will do Help lead the Paris data collection floor. Set the execution and quality bar for day-to-day collection

Vos missions : développer, organiser, réussir ! Développer le business : prospecter de nouveaux clients, identifier les opportunités, négocier les contrats et développer les partenariats et le sponsoring. Fédérer les talents : mobiliser et coordonner un réseau de partenaires, prestataires et experts de l'événementiel. Garantir la performance : maîtriser les coûts, suivre les marges et contribuer activement à la croissance du pôle. Le profil qui fera la différence Vous justifiez idéalement de 3 à 10 ans d'expérience dans l'événementiel , avec une réelle expertise commerciale et opérationnelle. Semula didirikan tahun 1986 oleh founder PT Astra International Tbk yaitu Bapak William Soeryadjaya dan keluarganya, dengan nama Yayasan Dana Pensiun Astra yang berkedudukan di Jakarta berdasarkan akta Notaris Ny. Rukmasanti Hardjasatya, SH nomor 70 tanggal 22 Desember. Berikut ini Lowongan Kerja Dana Pensiun Astra Terbaru. Filosofi dasar dari founder adalah kesejahteraan sosial yang layak bagi karyawan di hari tuanya. Kedua Dana Pensiun tersebut telah disahkan oleh Menteri Keuangan pada tanggal 6 September 2005. jobs.title: Rekrutmen RANS Entertainment Indonesia
jobs.description: PT RANS Entertainment Indonesia Tbk (RANS Entertainment) adalah perusahaan media kreatif, hiburan, dan ekosistem gaya hidup terintegrasi terkemuka di Indonesia. Didirikan pada 27 Desember 2015 oleh pasangan selebritas papan atas, Raffi Ahmad dan Nagita Slavina, nama perusahaan ini diambil dari gabungan inisial nama keduanya. Berawal dari sebuah kanal YouTube keluarga yang mendokumentasikan keseharian, RANS bertransformasi menjadi gurita bisnis berbasis Intellectual Property (IP) yang sangat kuat. Melalui strategi pemanfaatan media digital dan basis penggemar massal, perusahaan ini sukses memonetisasi berbagai sektor industri kreatif dan hiburan tanah air. Saat ini, lini bisnis RANS Entertainment tidak lagi terbatas pada produksi konten digital dan media sosial. Ekosistem bisnisnya telah menggurita ke berbagai pilar strategis, termasuk rumah produksi ( RANS Pictures ), label musik ( RANS Music ), agensi talenta, manajemen acara, hingga industri kuliner (F&B) dan produk konsumen. Tidak hanya itu, RANS juga merambah dunia olahraga profesional dengan mengelola klub sepak bola dan bola basket, serta berinvestasi di sektor pariwisata melalui proyek taman bermain ramah keluarga. Lowongan Kerja PT Rans Entertainmen Indonesia Tbk RANS Entertainment Saat ini RANS Entertainment memberikan kesempatan lowongan kerja untuk dapat bergabung bersama dengan posisi sebagai berikut: 1. FULL-TIME POSITIONS Accounting Manager Senior Legal Internal Audit HRGA Officer 2. PROJECT-BASED POSITIONS Account Executive Social Media 3. jobs.title: Rekrutmen Pengawal Energi Kementerian ESDM
jobs.description: Kementerian Energi dan Sumber Daya Mineral (Kementerian ESDM) adalah lembaga pemerintah Indonesia yang memegang peran vital dalam mengelola seluruh kekayaan alam non-hayati negara. Kementerian ini bertugas merumuskan dan melaksanakan kebijakan nasional di bidang minyak dan gas bumi, ketenagalistrikan, mineral dan batubara, serta pengembangan energi baru terbarukan dan konservasi energi. Dengan tanggung jawab yang besar, ESDM bergerak sebagai motor penggerak ketahanan energi nasional sekaligus pilar utama penerimaan negara bukan pajak (PNBP). jobs.title: Rekrutmen Teller Bank Danamon Indonesia
jobs.description: PT Bank Danamon Indonesia Tbk lebih dikenal dengan sebutan Bank Danamon atau Danamon saja merupakan sebuah bank di Indonesia yang memiliki slogan dan moto yaitu Saatnya Pegang Kendali berdiri pada tahun 1956. Bank ini menjadi bank pertama yang memelopori pertukaran mata uang asing dengan menjadi bank devisa pertama di Indonesia. Berikut ini adalah Lowongan Kerja PT Bank Danamon Indonesia Tbk. PT Bank Danamon Indonesia Tbk (IDX Code: BDMN) yang berdiri sejak 1956, per 30 Juni 2021 mengelola total aset konsolidasi sebesar Rp 194 triliun bersama anak perusahaannya, yaitu PT Adira Dinamika Multi Finance Tbk. (Adira Finance). Dalam hal kepemilikan saham, 92,47% saham Danamon dimiliki oleh MUFG Bank, Ltd. dan 7,53% dimiliki oleh publik.
